text:
Riley Thompson: Quick huddle notes  need to finalize a risk-balanced R3 slice for Optimize toolkit. Customers want clear wins: batching, cache hints, quant-lite presets, eval-sentry alerts. Can't overload runtime. Thoughts?
Mei Zhang: Agree. Propose prioritization by risk/impact: 1) safe batching heuristics (opt-in, reversible), 2) cache hints + quant-lite as advisory, 3) eval-sentry read-only alerts.
Owen Park: For batching, suggest two conservative modes: sticky-window batching (group same-prefix for short windows) and pacing-batcher (delay <50ms). Keep kernel changes for follow-up.
Tara Singh: Compliance asks: audit trail + export. Add one-line rationale generation from rule metadata: "Why: est -X% tokens. Risk: est +Y% p99." That should satisfy most pilots.
Riley Thompson: Draft acceptance criteria: - 3 pilot customers onboarded, - Console shows per-route token delta + p50/p95/p99, - p99 uplift <= 12% for enrolled routes, - recommendation adoption KPI >= 20%, - eval-sentry FP rate < 7% in pilot.
Mei Zhang: Add gating: per-customer feature flags, canary rollout percentages, and dashboard tiles for cost delta and alert volume.
Owen Park: Telemetry events: opt.r3.rule_eval, opt.r3.rule_suggested, opt.r3.rule_applied, opt.r3.alert_fired. Include rule_id, route, before_tokens_est, after_tokens_est.
Tara Singh: Ops/runbook note: define escalation path if noisy alerts exceed threshold. Pilot customers need direct support contact.
Riley Thompson: Implementation stance: batching = hard-enable mode for enrolled customers (with rollback), cache/quant = advisory only (API + Console cards), eval-sentry = read-only signals.
Mei Zhang: Owners: runtime = Owen, infra/telemetry = Mei, Console/pilot UX = Tara. Timeline 3 weeks: W1 spec + rule schema, W2 runtime prototype + perf baseline, W3 telemetry + Console + pilot rollouts.
Owen Park: Blocker: eng-runtime bandwidth for kernel batching. If blocked we'll implement batching in fronting scheduler to get pilot data.
Tara Singh: I'll draft pilot onboarding checklist and the audit CSV schema. Will post doc link in thread when ready.
prod-bot: Poll created "R3 priority order (risk-balanced)" options: [Batching, Cache+Quant advisories, Eval-sentry alerts] Vote: https://redwood.internal/poll/12121
Riley Thompson: Vote: Batching > Cache+Quant > Eval-sentry.
Mei Zhang: OK final call: lock R3 = batching heuristics (opt-in enrolled), advisory cache/quant recs with templated rationales + audit rows, eval-sentry read-only. Owners and timeline as above.
Owen Park: I'll post perf baseline numbers by EOD and create perf-run ticket.
Tara Singh: Will prepare pilot support contacts and runbook.
Riley Thompson: If no objections by EOD we freeze scope. :thumbsup:
Mei Zhang: +1
Owen Park: +1
Tara Singh: +1
